name: War Tycoon
creator: KizmoTek Studio
redeem: Launch War Tycoon on Roblox and spawn at your base.
Click the gear (settings) icon in the top left corner of the screen.
Open the Codes tab at the top of the menu.
Type the code in the Enter Code Here box exactly as shown, including capitals, and press Redeem.
notes:
War Tycoon is a military tycoon from KizmoTek Studio. You claim a base, collect cash from your droppers, and buy walls, defenses, guns, tanks, helicopters and jets to build it up. Other players build their bases on the same map, so you can raid them, defend yours and fight in vehicles. Rebirthing resets your base for lasting perks and more vehicles, and the latest update added the MV-75 Cheyenne II at Rebirth 7 plus vehicle stealing.

Codes hand out cash, medals, weapon skins and camo cases, and sometimes a double cash boost. WAR1MIL is the one to grab first, since a million cash pays for a big chunk of your base early on and the instant research unlock skips a wait in the War Lab. The game page says the next code arrives at 1.1 million likes, and codes also show up with big updates on X and Discord.

codes.reward: 1,000,000 Cash, 10 Medals, 1 Elite Camo Case and 1 instant War Lab research unlock

faq.q: Why is Wiki200k not working in War Tycoon?
faq.a: War Tycoon codes are case-sensitive. The working version ends in a capital K, Wiki200K, while the lowercase Wiki200k no longer works.

faq.q: When does the next War Tycoon code come out?
faq.a: The game's Roblox page says a new code will be released when it reaches 1.1 million likes. Giving the game a thumbs up helps it get there.
It was a limited code for the game passing one billion visits, and most recent checks show it has expired. Use WAR1MIL, Wiki200K and Boom instead.

tips: Build walls and defenses early. They keep raiders out while you collect cash and finish the rest of your base.
Some vehicles unlock by level, not rebirth, like the Tornado ASSTA at Level 50. Playing and fighting also opens up new gear.
The latest update added vehicle stealing, so do not leave your tank or jet sitting near an enemy base where someone can take it.
Progress and game passes save automatically, so you can leave and come back later without losing the base you built.
useRewards: Redeem WAR1MIL early, when a million cash makes the biggest difference to your base. Use the instant War Lab unlock on a long research you do not want to wait for, if you get to choose. The Medals and Elite Camo Case are nice extras. Wiki200K and Boom only give weapon skins, so they change how your guns look, not how they fight.
codeChannels: The KizmoTek Discord server, the War Tycoon X account, and like goals announced on the game's Roblox page
